description:
Confirmed: .github/workflows/site-inputs.yml report-failure (about lines 131-155) opens or comments on one 'site-bundle-failed' issue and has no close path; its own text says 'Close this issue once a bundle succeeds again' but nothing does it. The same label is also used by the site repo's relay of site-side deploy failures (deploy.yml report-failure, lines 223-238), so core build failures and site deploy failures share one issue (#2979: 37 comments, six distinct causes; closed #2886 had 31).
Work (core side): (1) core bundle build failures keep label site-bundle-failed; a successful site-inputs run on develop comments and closes the open issue (D7 style evidence comment); (2) classify the failure (parent-bundle-missing, not-trunk-certified, other) in a hidden marker and comment only when the class or the failing core commit changes class (no identical consecutive comments); (3) define the label for site-side relay issues: site-bundle-undeployed, created by the workflow itself with the existing 'gh label create --force' pattern (a label this item names, allowed by G7); (4) honor an explicit expected-rejection marker (see the site reporter item) and never create an incident for it.
Expected rejections seen: #2850 (manual dispatch before Trunk certified: refused as designed) and #2851 (deliberate wrong-digest negative probe).
